newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's pension funds register 6.64 mln workers.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's pension funds register 6.64 mln workers.

text.p: A total of 6,637,858 Mexican workers had opted by Aug. 1 to register for newly privitized pension funds, known as Afores, the government said in a statement late Tuesday.

Retirement savings contributions by private sector employers were managed by the government's Social Security Institute until July 1. Since then, about 10.5 million workers have been able to choose a privately managed Afore.
The National Retirement Savings Commission (Consar) said 1.46 million workers registered with the afore from Bancomer.
The pension fund with Banamex registered 1.06 million workers followed by the pension fund with Santander in Mexico with 824,002 workers, it added.
